flags.message: Before reading the blinding instructions in full, the evaluator's initial local file inventory listed committed predictor directory and artifact paths. No committed prediction contents, repository history, redacted-text search, alias machinery, or alias map was read. The exposed names were disregarded, and all grading used only codex-baseline through gemini-baseline from record/blinded.

All three blinded candidate rationales report that the frozen context counted 6 amicus briefs while the August 16 snapshot contained 13 amicus docket entries; one rationale attributes the difference to singular versus plural amicus captions. The resolved outcome also records 6. Maintainers should verify whether the interim amicus counter omits plural-caption entries.
